grade.description: The inspection grade of a return line.

outcome.description:
The disposition outcome. Only RESTOCK has a downstream effect
(`ReturnLineStaged`); the others are recorded for audit.

policyVersion.description: The policy version the decision used (an override keeps the original's).

supersedes.description: The disposition this override supersedes; absent on a policy decision.

reason.description: Mandatory on an override; absent on a policy decision.

staged.description: True once this RESTOCK disposition raised ReturnLineStaged; always false for other outcomes.
